quote_english: There were 18,000 villages that did not have access to electricity when we came to power. We have completed the work of providing electricity to 16,000 villages.
summary: BOOM rated true: 16,282 of 18,452 unelectrified villages had been electrified by 5 February 2018 per the GARV dashboard, though only 1,290 villages (8%) had every household connected.

analysis:
On 5 February 2018 Shah said about 18,000 villages lacked electricity when the government took office and that work had been completed in 16,000.

BOOM used the Ministry of Power's GARV dashboard: 16,282 of 18,452 villages had been electrified as of 5 February 2018, which matches the claim.

Only 1,290 of the villages (about 8 percent) had all households connected (BOOM). The statement is accurate on the metric used, but 'electrified village' is not the same as every household having power.
notes: The GARV dashboard URL is a live page and may show different numbers now. English wording from BOOM. No video found.
